text_block_list.text: *rub-rub-rub-rub*~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ? What was that voice...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's just Jordan-san~.
Thank goodness you're not a ghost~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Curren-chan!?
No way, the real deal!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this place is literally a power spot!
Hey, hey, let's take a pic!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Three, two, one☆
*Click*☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! '#PowerSpot'
'#UltimateShot' '#WishedForItAndGotIt'
'#BeautifulGirl' '#MiraculousCuteness'...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! I'm totally in the way, aren't I?
Well, see ya later☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Wah, you startled me~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, Jordan-san was all smiles
after taking the '#BestShotEver'♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Curren is such a good girl♪
I granted Jordan-san's wish!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it's true that without Curren Chan,
Tosen Jordan's wish
would never have come true."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, in a way, it's thanks to Curren Chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Hey, Onii-chan,
what would you wish for if it were you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Hey, Onee-chan,
what would you wish for if it were you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If it's a power spot, if it's next to Curren...
...Anything can come true. Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Curren... wants to stay with Onii-chan
a whole lot longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Curren... wants to stay with Onee-chan
a whole lot longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the cell phone in my pocket began to ring.
Answering the call—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Trainer-san?
I'm so sorry for calling out of nowhere,
but reporters are storming the academy—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "They asked if they could interview Curren Chan-san and her Trainer right away. May we accept this offer?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did Curren's wish come true?
Ehehe, if it did...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's just 'cause Curren is so cute♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up spending a little more time
with Curren Chan, who seemed to be in
fantastic spirits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The power of cuteness is incredible...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Trainer-san?
I'm so sorry for calling out of nowhere,
but the Chairwoman has summoned you..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Would it be possible to return to the academy right away?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Judging by that look, did the exact opposite
of what Curren asked for happen?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aargh, what a bummer. I wonder if Curren's not feeling well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan was gazing up at the sky
with a melancholic look on her face...
